Continuous active hull hypothesis: narrow screen (kT + Sol brief, 2026-11-22). NON-CANON research.
ALL bodies. ALL sponsors. 2026-2226.

Question (stopping condition): does a continuous field-generating hull change the existing field's controllable
behaviour, or is it only a different means of generating the same field? Specifically: can surface-controlled asymmetry
give lasting ordinary velocity after shutdown, with conservation intact? Existing physics only.

Existing model (lane): fields are prescribed geometry on flat slices, slow limit, c = 1 units where convenient.
  shift  b(x, t): matter law  L = 1/2 |xdot - b|^2      ->  dw_i/dt = -w_j d_i b_j,   w = xdot - b
  lapse/potential Phi(x, t) (the W2 cushion type; the lane's "lapse dash"): xddot = -grad Phi (acceleration field)
  Required stress-energy (3+1): for the shift, E = -K^2/16pi with K_ij = -1/2 (d_i b_j + d_j b_i): nonzero only where b varies.
Three checks:
  A. Where must the field's GR source sit for the Tic Tac's R 15 / d 2 field? (hull skin vs wall shell)
  B. Asymmetric shift (any profile, surface-steered): final ordinary velocity of a hull starting at rest.
  C. Asymmetric potential (directional gradient): final ordinary velocity, and the field's own momentum (conservation).

A_source_location.reading: The stress-energy the field needs sits in the wall shell 9-13 m outside the hull, whoever generates it. A skin source is no closer to it than the 8 t module was: both need the relational sector to act at a distance (S_R unspecified).
A_source_location.wall_at_skin: Moving the wall onto the skin is a different field, not a better generator: the lane shows a shift wall cutting the hull strains it exponentially (158 g case).

B_asymmetric_shift.result: w stays 0 to rounding in every random asymmetric, time-dependent profile: the hull is displaced and left at its original velocity
B_asymmetric_shift.reason: dw/dt = -(grad b) w is linear and homogeneous in w: no shift geometry, however finely the surface controls it, gives lasting velocity

C_directional_potential.fixed_field_note: a field fixed in space: the hull leaves through the reverse walls (integral of grad Phi = 0) and loses the gain; the field must travel with the vehicle
C_directional_potential.result: YES: a directional potential gives lasting ordinary velocity after shutdown while the hull stays inside the field (the cushion mechanism, pointed sideways)
C_directional_potential.already_in_lane: WEAVE_GEOMETRY_COMPARE_2026_11_21: the lapse dash is exactly a horizontal potential push (uniform interior push with reverse walls, peak wall strength 2.6-11.5x the interior). The W2 cushion is the vertical case. Direction is not constrained by the model; "vertical only" was an operating booking, not physics.
C_directional_potential.conservation: Field momentum (ADM) is identically zero for a compact field on flat slices, so the hull's momentum must go to an external partner (R1). Same unresolved exchange law and partner as the vertical cushion and the dash; energy is booked by assumption (eta), not derived.
C_directional_potential.in_air: a potential push moves the hull through the air (drag, wake, boom), unlike the shift: horizontal acceleration to orbital speed belongs above the atmosphere

verdict.stopping_condition: The continuous active hull is a different means of generating the same fields. In the existing model it does not change controllable behaviour: the model prescribes field geometry directly, has no generator-to-field law (S_R unspecified), and the required source sits in the wall shell 9-13 m off the hull either way.
verdict.what_does_give_lasting_velocity: Not hull continuity but field TYPE: shift never (theorem of the adopted law); potential/lapse type always could, in any direction (already in the lane). Directional acceleration is therefore a capability-and-energy booking decision, independent of the hull hypothesis.
precise_missing: constitutive law of the relational sector: which potential fields are attainable, at what energy cost, power and duration (S_R)
verdict.correction_to_torchless_screen: 80ade29 said the cushion is "established only vertically". More precisely: the model already contains the horizontal potential push (lane lapse dash); only the energy/operating booking is vertical. The torchless verdict is unchanged: it still needs a TJ-class source and an explicit capability grant.
verdict.hypothesis_value: Strong as LOOM narrative and as a candidate form for the missing constitutive law (surface-sourced relational sector); not testable in this model.
